method: Every final revised page individually viewed using view_image, after the final build.
page_images_location: External publication closeout: verification/pages/; intentionally not duplicated into Git.

pages.observation: P01: publication status and revised preparation note complete; accented author and preparation date correct; title and abstract fit.
Question and raw registration legible, no collisions; references resolve.
Positioned axes, circle and central vertex definitions complete; coordinate convention clear.
Dictionary table and exchange/profile equations legible; footer and margins clear.
Native step and ball-preimage proposition complete; endpoint discussion readable.
Close-sphere table and Figure 1 legible, including all labels and caption.
M01: equation 3.9 shows complement superscript c without comma; signed work and jump count remain intact.
M02: fixed unshifted forcing and backward-characteristic explanation readable; Q01 and equality witness intact; launch expansion fits.
Receiving theorem, launch coefficient and first post-F quantifiers legible; no clipped equation.
Hull proof, cylindrical radius, scalar gap and Lipschitz calculation complete.
Clearance theorem and both Figure 2 panels/legend/caption legible; no overlap.
No-crossing corollary, transport distinctions and phase proposition complete.
M03: width-one 297/5000 and commonly scaled 297 w_host/5000 distinguished; arclength condition, C6 formula and unloaded scope intact.
Synthesis, three missing-registration ingredients and evidence-count qualifications readable.
Exact rational certificates and complete claim table readable; no overflow.
All notation crosswalk rows legible, including ball/cylindrical radius and static/time distinctions.
All nine references complete, accented names and immutable links readable.
